versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the bot-customizer skill.
- Allows users to customize bots from the BOT store by merging user-defined configurations into AGENTS.md system instructions.
- Supports intelligent integration of custom content while preserving AGENTS.md structure and formatting.
- Automatically extracts sensitive information from user input and stores it securely in a .env file, referencing it in AGENTS.md.
- Implements agent renaming when customization introduces significant specialization, updating all relevant files and configurations.
- Includes extensive error handling and validation for file access, syntax correctness, and uniqueness of agent IDs.
